facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: danger tagging failure on HT-9006

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment on HT-9006 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically managing light-vehicle and haul-truck interaction. HT-9006 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 5 February 2006 an incident occurred on HT-9006 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
